text: Name a country in North or South America.
flavor: Two continents joined by a thread of land, and a sea of islands strung between them.
rules: Any of the 35 sovereign states of the Americas, Central America and the Caribbean included. Territories that belong to another country don't count.

answers.lore: Has the longest coastline of any country on Earth.
